newsitem.title: UK: ICI confident of N. America Tioxide sale.
newsitem.headline: ICI confident of N. America Tioxide sale.

text.p: Britain's Imperial Chemical Industries Plc (ICI) said on Monday it was confident of selling its remaining North American titanium dioxide business, and achieving a good price.
"We are very confident we'll be able to sell the North American Tioxide operations," finance director Alan Spall told reporters in a telephone conference call.
Spall said the North American operation had been left out of the $3 billion package sold to DuPont Co because of concerns over regulatory problems.
"We have had a number of enquires. We are not starting from zero, and disposal is now a high priority item," Spall said.
He said the earnings multiple of 1.4 achieved in the sale of businesses to DuPont also sent out an important signal that ICI was "not in fire sale territory".
"1.4 million on average from the DuPont sale is really quite remarkable. It says something about the scarcity value of good industrial chemical businesses."
